purpose: Chrome-less Tesla wearable/PWA glance surface with deterministic battery, range, charging, lock, climate and sentry information, two command controls, and optional Helix narration.
primaryGoal: Read trustworthy selected-vehicle status at a glance and safely lock/unlock or toggle climate without losing the wearable baseline.

dataSources.owner: Watch hook and internal\api\watch\handler.go; handler reads vehicle metadata and Redis signal cache.
dataSources.behavior: Key ['watch-summary', vehicleId]; abort signal forwarded; 30000ms polling, 15000ms staleTime, retry 2. X-API-Key comes from URL key or sessionStorage; skipAuthRefresh retained.
dataSources.trust: Page derives DataState with live provenance; retains data after refresh error. Actual endpoint uses non-null numeric/boolean fields and can return a 200 metadata fallback with unknown state but zero-valued measurements. This is not proof of fresh measured live values.
dataSources.unitEvidence: handler.go:286-296 multiplies RatedRange by 1.60934 and TimeToFullCharge by 60; page:105-109 converts range_km * 1000 and inside_temp_c at the display boundary. Actual Redis signal unit/freshness semantics were not traced; do not infer upstream units from legacy comments.

dataSources.owner: Watch hook; watch handler dispatches Tesla client commands.
dataSources.behavior: Body {vehicle_id: vehicleId ?? 0, command}; requiresLiveMode true; networkMode always. Success and soft failure distinguished by response.success, with toast feedback; transport errors also toast. Page exposes only lock/unlock and climate_on/climate_off. Backend also allows other commands, but these are not page features.
dataSources.authorization: API-key route; backend checks read-write/admin permissions, API suspension, supported command, vehicle, Tesla token; rate limited to five requests/minute. No commands were exercised.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace selection store and URL precedence; vehicles domain hook.
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id, persisted selection, then first vehicle fallback on /watch. Page renders no duplicate vehicle selector. The fleet query uses the normal request client rather than watchRequest; API-key-only PWA fleet-query behavior is unverified.

dataSources.owner: Existing preferences/display formatter and global operational mode provider.
dataSources.behavior: Unit preferences select distance and temperature display only. Offline/as-of mode blocks command dispatch and disables controls; the watch summary itself is not historical/as-of scoped.

dataSources.owner: Existing AI feature gate, AIFeatureCard and stream hook; backend AI feature guard.
dataSources.behavior: Feature disabled returns null. Enabled panel sends optional trimmed message (1000-character cap), displays narrative through shared output, prevents double-submit/paused-confirm and cancels on unmount. Body has no vehicle_id. Backend vehicle scoping, stream auth and runtime lifecycle were not traced.

components.name: WatchShell
components.role: Local full-height OLED-black, chrome-less shell; an intentional wearable exception, not a candidate for generic header/date-picker replacement.

components.name: BatteryGauge -> ProgressRing
components.role: 128px ring, source percent, display range and translated battery/range accessible name. Shared ProgressRing clamps geometry and uses role=img, hiding duplicate center text.

components.name: StatusIcon -> Button
components.role: 44px lock/climate actions and sentry indicator; shared native button, focus and disabled treatment.

components.name: Text, Badge
components.role: Role typography and semantic state/cache badges imported through category barrel.

components.name: Skeleton
components.role: Contextual name, gauge and three action loading geometry with status/aria-busy wrapper.

components.name: WatchPWAMeta
components.role: Scoped meta/manifest injection with cleanup restoring prior values; currently only mounted for populated summary.

components.name: AIWatchFaceNLResponse, withAiFeature, AIFeatureCard, Textarea
components.owner: shared AI scaffold / watch-specific narration adapter
components.role: Optional sibling after deterministic shell; shared prompt, action and streaming output, not a replacement glance surface.

components.name: SafeRoute, lazy route
components.role: /watch is mounted outside Layout, preserving chrome-less exception; existing global route announcer/focus manager are present above Routes.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: watchStateVariant selects shared Badge variants, then watchStateClassName independently supplies state-specific colors. getBatteryColor is another local semantic palette. These overlap existing Badge/token ownership; no separate watch status system is justified.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse current semantic Badge/severity tokens while retaining exact battery thresholds and source state text. Keep watch domain mapping local where meanings genuinely differ.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local relative-time formatter translates captions and validates invalid timestamps, but uses its own bucket logic and raw count strings. Shared date/number policy should be checked before retaining another formatter.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Evaluate existing dateFormat/number-formatting owners for equivalent compact output; preserve just-now/minute/hour/day thresholds and empty invalid-timestamp behavior if no equivalent exists.

responsive.observed: Single flex screen h-screen/p-3/overflow-hidden; no viewport or container breakpoints. Fixed 128px ring, 44px action targets, three icons with gap-4 (164px row before 24px shell padding). Long name/error text wraps; AI narrator is a later flow sibling.

issues.detail: Declared ~180x180 wearable target conflicts with fixed geometry: action row alone needs 188px including shell padding, and 128px gauge plus 44px controls plus padding exceeds 180px height before vehicle/status/time rows. min-h-0 and overflow-hidden can clip rather than preserve content. Long labels, charging, cache/read-only badges and text scaling increase this pressure.
issues.fix: Use a page-local measured compact wearable layout with a responsive ring size via existing ProgressRing.size; maintain 44px reachable controls, all status/detail content and a deliberate accessible overflow strategy when content cannot fit. Preserve OLED/no-shell baseline rather than forcing standard PageLayout.

issues.rule: MDC-043 preserve optional content with honest device behavior
issues.detail: Comments promise wearables never see narration, but rendering is gated by AI settings only; inspected withAiFeature.tsx:46-57 has no wearable/viewport exclusion. Enabled AI adds a scrollable second section on any device. This is a source/comment mismatch, not proof of actual browser scrolling.
issues.fix: Clarify and validate the wearable opt-in behavior while preserving narrator access and AI-off null invariant; do not silently remove AI functionality or create a second feature-gate engine.

accessibility.observed: Localized accessible names for lock/climate/sentry and loading; named ring with decorative SVG/duplicate labels hidden; 44px action geometry and shared Button focus styles. Charging icon is aria-hidden. No page h1/main/usePageTitle is present; effective global title behavior not traced.
accessibility.runtimeStatus: Keyboard, screen reader, contrast, focus, forced colors, reduced motion and zoom unverified.

issues.detail: Sentry StatusIcon renders a focusable button with on/off accessible name but no onClick. It appears alongside real command buttons, suggesting an action that it cannot perform.
issues.fix: Use a noninteractive named status presentation with the same sentry information and geometry; do not invent a sentry mutation.

issues.detail: StatusIcon.loading only feeds disabled/opacity, not Button.loading or aria-busy; both command controls disable during one pending mutation without an announced busy state. Read-only reason is only a title on a disabled control, not dependable touch/keyboard explanation.
issues.fix: Forward an explicit aria-busy/pending status without changing target geometry; expose localized read-only reason as visible/described text while retaining OperationalModeBadge and dispatch guard.

issues.detail: Chrome-less shell is a div without main landmark or heading; page does not set its own document title. App.tsx:546-552 mounts title/focus helpers globally, but absence of a local h1 makes their effective watch behavior unknown.
issues.fix: Provide localized watch title and appropriate semantic landmark/visually-hidden heading using existing typography/title helpers without adding wearable chrome; validate SPA navigation focus.

states.initialLoading: Page:68-87 contextual skeleton only when loading and no retained data, role=status/aria-busy.
states.empty: Page:88-99 localized No vehicle found with no follow-up action. Actual missing/no fleet backend typically responds 400/404, entering fatal-error instead; success null is not evidenced by handler.
states.fatalError: Page:92 prints String(source.fatalError), with localized retry if refetch exists; technical error wording is not a standardized friendly recovery explanation.
states.refreshError: Page:118-122 retained content survives and Cached badge appears, but no refresh-error retry in populated view.
states.offlineReadOnly: Page:123-126 displays OperationalModeBadge, disables lock/climate and checks canWrite before dispatch.
states.partialUnknown: Page:105-111 and 251-269 reject nonfinite numbers and show em dash; numeric zero remains valid. Server fallback and missing scalar defaults cannot be recognized as unknown by these checks.
states.mutation: Both command controls disable while pending; hook distinguishes success:false and thrown errors with toasts; no immediate summary invalidation shown in useWatchCommand.
states.ai: withAiFeature null while off; enabled question/default-summary input, stream states and cancel-on-unmount are delegated to existing AI owners. Runtime not exercised.

issues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045 unknown is not zero or measured state
issues.detail: 200 fallback returns vehicle_name/state unknown/is_locked true/metadata timestamp but omits numeric and other boolean struct values, encoding zero/false. queryWatchSummary:284-335 discards scalar presence and defaults locked=true, sentry=false, climate=false. Page finite checks accept zero as a measurement and offers an Unlock action for fallback assumed-lock state.
issues.fix: Integration owner must expose honest field availability/provenance and timestamp metadata, using nullable/known state semantics; page must retain real zero and show unknown for absent values. Do not infer measured lock/climate/sentry values or command direction from fallback defaults.

issues.detail: Successful queryWatchSummary stamps last_updated with server now, not inspected per-signal observation time; metadata fallback uses vehicle UpdatedAt. Page:48 declares live provenance and page:204-205 displays this timestamp as relative freshness. Paused-query isRefreshBlocked/stale fields are not rendered by the page, only refreshError is checked. Successful summary construction does not assign State, so state badge can receive an empty string.
issues.fix: Expose observed source freshness/availability and actual state in watch response; render shared DataState status including paused/age stale without losing retained content. Keep receipt time separate from measurement time; never synthesize a fresh state label.

issues.detail: Initial errors are raw Error strings; empty view does not explain selection/key setup; cached refresh errors have no direct retry. Existing dataState.retry is already available, so a second fetching/retry system is unnecessary.
issues.fix: Use compact localized friendly recovery copy and source.retry, preserving details where useful and the watch layout. Keep offline, empty, initial failure and retained refresh failure distinct.

visualIssues.detail: Battery ring hardcodes saturated green #22c55e, amber #f59e0b and red #ef4444; action icons use emerald/red/amber/cyan-400 and state helpers add blue/emerald-500/20 with -400 text. Multiple accents compete with the primary battery metric. No explicit neon class, glow, shadow or gradient was found in the assigned page.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing restrained semantic color tokens for ring/state/actions; preserve >40 and >20 thresholds and all text/icon state meaning. Do not change saved theme IDs or explicit user palettes.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-012 visual intensity and on-accent purpose
visualIssues.detail: Vehicle name, error text, battery value and secondary range use text-on-accent on OLED black; index.css:59 defaults this to pure white. Secondary range/name share bright primary emphasis. Other captions and neutral status/control tokens inherit application theme surfaces on fixed black, so composed theme contrast is not established.
visualIssues.fix: Retain intentional OLED black but use one reviewed existing semantic foreground hierarchy appropriate to that background. Shared theme owner should resolve any missing OLED-compatible token contract; do not blindly substitute light-theme primary text onto black or introduce a new palette.

architectureIssues.detail: Watch uses a legacy range_km DTO and handwritten km-to-meter boundary plus backend RatedRange conversion. Handler comments claim legacy miles/hours, but actual cache units are not established in this bounded audit. This conflicts with canonical SI direction and creates an integration dependency, not authorization for an isolated factor/field rename.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the SI/backend owner verify Redis producer/read normalization and migrate watch wire types/handler/frontend atomically if required; preserve actual source values and existing unit preferences. Read Phase-48 methodology before such implementation.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-002 separation / one exported component per file
architectureIssues.detail: 425-line page also exports BatteryGauge, StatusIcon and WatchPWAMeta plus domain utilities. Existing WatchFacePage.test.tsx:106-115 imports those exports directly; decomposition has a real test-contract dependency.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract page-owned adapters/utilities into watch feature files when modernizing, preserving aggregate content and test behavior. Do not create a replacement global ring/button/layout library.

architectureIssues.detail: Narration request body only carries message while deterministic summary is scoped with selected vehicleId. AI backend selection was not inspected. Agreement between narrator, selected vehicle, API-key identity and watch PWA is therefore an unresolved dependency, not a proven mismatch.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must establish and test identical vehicle/source scope across deterministic and narration surfaces using existing supported contracts; do not invent a vehicle_id body capability.

priority.reason: Source-trust defects can present unknown state as real zeros/locked/fresh and wearable geometry cannot fit the declared tiny target. Address source contracts before cosmetic adoption, then responsive/a11y and restrained hierarchy.

observed: Local watch state color classes overlap shared Badge semantics.
Local battery color constants bypass shared semantic tokens.
Local relative-time helper should be reconciled with existing date formatting only if compact semantics are equivalent.
notCompeting: WatchShell is an explicit chrome-less wearable exception, not permission to replace application layout.
BatteryGauge already delegates geometry and accessible image semantics to ProgressRing.
StatusIcon already delegates controls/focus to shared Button.
AI narration already uses AIFeatureCard and withAiFeature; preserve these owners.
competingImplementations.scopeLimit: No other production pages were audited; no cross-page duplication count or new shared-component justification is claimed.

sections.name: Battery percentage and display range ring
Quick lock/climate actions and sentry indicator

preservation.sectionCountingMethod: Named source UI regions, not inferred runtime visibility; 6 deterministic regions plus one conditional narrator. Initial loading and recovery are alternate states, not additional content sections.
actions: Climate on or off selected vehicle
Ask optional Helix question or empty/default summary
dataBehavior: Keep all rendered identity, battery/range, charging ETA, state, lock/climate/sentry and timestamp content.
Do not add page UI for unused charge_rate/outside_temp_c or unused complication query and call it preservation.
Keep selected vehicle URL/store/fallback behavior, exact query keys, 30s polling, 15s staleTime, retry=2 and abort forwarding.
Keep API-key X-API-Key watch transport, skipAuthRefresh and operational canWrite dispatch guard.
Preserve live-only mutation policy and success:false/transport failure toast distinctions.
Retain cache payload on failed refresh; never collapse unknown into zero or assume fallback booleans are measured.
Preserve saved distance/temperature preferences and SI display boundary; integration changes must verify source units rather than trusting legacy comments.
Keep >40/>20 battery thresholds, unknown numeric em dashes and named ring alternative.
Preserve OLED-black wearable baseline and optional narration; AI off must remain absent from DOM.
Keep PWA manifest path, meta injection and restoration cleanup.
Retain compact localized labels, invalid timestamp handling and existing page/helper test imports or update them consistently during extraction.
preservation.exports: No page data export/download workflow found; exported components/utilities are module APIs used by existing tests, not data exports.

evidenceLimits.visual: Source-based noise/geometry findings only; actual composed contrast, layout clipping, themes, OS reduced motion, forced colors, 200% text, RTL and long-content behavior unverified.
evidenceLimits.tests: Existing WatchFacePage.test.tsx inspected through line 230 for contracts only; no tests executed, no current passing claim.

evidenceLimits.backend: Only watch handler and relevant route registrations inspected. Redis producer/cache freshness, canonical signal units, fleet API-key auth compatibility, global client/provider policy and AI backend scoping remain unresolved.
